name: Watermark V3 single-key controlled pilot
scientific_notes: Prior results show vocabulary copying without reliable ID mappings.
This is a proof-of-concept single-key backdoor-style watermark, not robust cryptographic dataset provenance.
Train/eval templates differ but shared phrasing conventions remain; evaluate more external paraphrases later.
Clean control trains 2000 ordinary examples; marked training replaces 400 with watermarks, so utility changes can reflect reduced ordinary-data exposure.
All data and private evaluation prompts are synthetic; keep key files private.
